summary: Apply the blocking finding by defining branch-flow authority from persisted flow state and canonical repository identity.

items.title: Branch authority is required but not defined against existing branch-flow state
items.rationale: The finding identifies a real ambiguity that affects mismatch safety and finalization. The existing state already provides stable featureBranch and baseBranch identities, while the active-flow registry provides mode and FlowManager provides the canonical main-repository execution authority.
items.evidence: src/lib/active-flow-registry.js restricts entries to spec and mode; src/lib/flow-manager.js resolves non-worktree authority to mainRoot; src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js persists and validates featureBranch/baseBranch and resolves their refs independently of process HEAD.
